responsibility: Provides the C-SKY target’s Linux/ELF driver, runtime, and ABI integration layer. It defines Linux start/end files, dynamic linker naming, multilib sysroot suffix rules, assembler and linker specs, profiling hooks, PIC crt helper assembly, cache-flush support for __clear_cache, CPP builtins for the GNU user environment, and marks sync/atomic compare-and-swap support so GCC exposes the expected Linux-target predefined macros and runtime behavior.
